notes: Fixed two Vue 3 Options API bugs. Bug 1: Methods defined at root level of Options API object (not inside methods:) are not available via this — _applySavedSettings and _handleKeyboard in createCollageLifecycle.js caused TypeError during mounted(). Fix: moved them into a methods: { } block. Bug 2: Object spread order silently overwrites properties — ...lifecycleConfig after methods: methodsConfig replaced all template-referenced methods (triggerFilePicker, undo, redo, etc.) with only lifecycle helper methods. Vue render warnings + isTitleFormatActive TypeError. Fix: explicitly merge both method sources and reference lifecycle hooks by name instead of spreading. Both bugs are documented in updated vue-options-api-pattern.md learnings.
